capture.title: Capture traffic
capture.webNotice: Capturing traffic needs the desktop app, which can listen on a local port and forward to your API.
capture.limitation: Point your app at the local address instead of the API. An app whose base URL cannot be changed is not captured.
capture.upstreamPlaceholder: API to forward to, for example https://api.example.com
capture.idleHint: Enter the API your app talks to, then start the capture.
capture.listening: Requests your app sends to {{address}} appear here.
capture.upgraded: This request switched to a WebSocket. Its frames are forwarded but not recorded.
capture.interrupted: The response ended before it was complete.
capture.truncated: This body was forwarded whole, but only its first 2 MB are kept here.
capture.filterPlaceholder: Filter by method, path or status

captureAction.nothingToSave: None of the selected exchanges can be saved as a request.
captureAction.noLongerKept: That exchange is no longer kept. Gostman keeps the latest 500.
captureAction.savedTopLevel_one: Saved {{count}} request to the top level.
captureAction.savedTopLevel_other: Saved {{count}} requests to the top level.
captureAction.withheld: Left out these request headers: {{headers}}. Add credentials as variables before sending.
captureAction.duplicates_one: Skipped {{count}} duplicate of the same method, path and body.
captureAction.duplicates_other: Skipped {{count}} duplicates of the same method, path and body.
captureAction.unsavable_one: Skipped {{count}} exchange that failed or switched to a WebSocket.
captureAction.unsavable_other: Skipped {{count}} exchanges that failed or switched to a WebSocket.
captureAction.withoutExample_one: Kept no example for {{count}} response that arrived incomplete.
captureAction.withoutExample_other: Kept no example for {{count}} responses that arrived incomplete.
captureAction.incomplete_one: {{count}} request had a body larger than 2 MB, which is saved incomplete.
captureAction.incomplete_other: {{count}} requests had a body larger than 2 MB, which is saved incomplete.
captureAction.bodyNote: Bodies are saved as they were captured. Check them for tokens or personal data before sharing the collection.
